expert.description:
{Expert Summon Boat}

Summons an existing, neutral or own, unoccupied boat from anywhere in the world to your location.  If no such boats exist, one is created.

{Expert Scuttle Boat}

Destroys a boat of caster's choice in hero visibility zone.  Use with caution, the effects are permanent.

none.description:
{Visions}

Provides you with exact numbers of wandering monsters and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero, flee or be acquired via Diplomacy skill (exact fee will be revealed). Range is equal to Spell Power or three, whichever is greater. Valid for 1 turn.

basic.description:
{Basic Visions}

Provides you with exact numbers of wandering monsters and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero, flee or be acquired via Diplomacy skill (exact fee will be revealed). Range is equal to Spell Power or three, whichever is greater. Valid for 1 turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Visions}

Provides you with exact numbers of wandering monsters and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero, flee or be acquired via Diplomacy skill (exact fee will be revealed).  Allows you to view a nearby enemy hero's general statistics, creature type and quantity, as if the hero was part of your kingdom. Range is (Spell Power x 2) or three, whichever is greater. Valid for 1 turn.

expert.description:
{Expert Visions}

Provides you with exact numbers of wandering monsters and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero, flee or be acquired via Diplomacy skill (exact fee will be revealed).  Allows you to view a nearby enemy hero's general statistics, creature type and quantity, as if the hero was part of your kingdom, as well as a nearby town's statistics, garrison creatures and quantity. Range is (Spell Power x 3) or three, whichever is greater. Valid for 1 turn.

none.description:
{View Earth}

Reveals the location of all resources to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

basic.description:
{Basic View Earth}

Reveals the location of all resources to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced View Earth}

Reveals the location of all resources and mines to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

expert.description:
{Expert View Earth}

Reveals the location of all resources and mines and reveals all terrain to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

none.description:
{Disguise}

Makes all units in your hero army look like your most powerful unit to enemies trying to view your hero for 1 turn.  Numbers in each group are unchanged.

basic.description:
{Basic Disguise}

Makes all units in your hero army look like your most powerful unit to enemies trying to view your hero for 1 turn.  Numbers in each group are unchanged.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Disguise}

Makes all units in your hero army look like your most powerful unit to enemies trying to view your hero for 1 turn.  Numbers in each group appear as zero.

expert.description:
{Expert Disguise}

Makes all units in your hero army look like the most powerful unit affiliated to player starting town to enemies trying to view your hero for 1 turn.  Numbers in each group appear as zero.

none.description:
{View Air}

Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

basic.description:
{Basic View Air}

Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced View Air}

Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts, plus enemy heroes to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

expert.description:
{Expert View Air}

Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts, plus enemy heroes and all towns to the caster. After casting, the information can be accessed through View World window until the end of the turn.

none.description:
{Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain with 40% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

basic.description:
{Basic Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain with 40% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain with 20% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

expert.description:
{Expert Fly}

Allows your army to fly over obstacles and rough terrain without any penalty. Valid for 1 turn. You must land at the end of the turn.

none.description:
{Water Walk}

Allows your army to walk across bodies of water with 40% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must end your movement on dry land.

basic.description:
{Basic Water Walk}

Allows your army to walk across bodies of water with 40% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must end your movement on dry land.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Water Walk}

Allows your army to walk across bodies of water with 20% penalty to movement cost. Valid for 1 turn. You must end your movement on dry land.

expert.description:
{Expert Water Walk}

Allows your army to walk across bodies of water without any penalty. Valid for 1 turn. You must end your movement on dry land.

none.description:
{Dimension Door}

Once per day (for each hero), you may teleport your hero to an unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 300 movement points.

basic.description:
{Basic Dimension Door}

Twice per day (for each hero), you may teleport your hero to an unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 300 movement points.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Dimension Door}

Three times per day (for each hero), you may teleport your hero to an unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 300 movement points.

expert.description:
{Expert Dimension Door}

Four times per day (for each hero), you may teleport your hero to an unoccupied location on the adventure map in hero visibility zone. This spends 200 movement points.

none.description:
{Town Portal}

Teleports your hero to the nearest friendly town. Requires 300 movement points. The town must be unoccupied.

basic.description:
{Basic Town Portal}

Teleports your hero to the nearest friendly town. Requires 300 movement points. The town must be unoccupied.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Town Portal}

Teleports your hero to any chosen friendly town. Requires 300 movement points. The town must be unoccupied.

expert.description:
{Expert Town Portal}

Teleports your hero to any chosen friendly town. Requires 200 movement points. The town must be unoccupied.

none.description:
{Quicksand}

Randomly places four small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a non-flying unit's movement for the turn and makes quicksand visible to all. Quicksand duration is unlimited.

basic.description:
{Basic Quicksand}

Randomly places four small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a non-flying unit's movement for the turn and makes quicksand visible to all. Quicksand duration is unlimited.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Quicksand}

Randomly places six small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a non-flying unit's movement for the turn and makes quicksand visible to all. Quicksand duration is unlimited.

expert.description:
{Expert Quicksand}

Randomly places eight small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a non-flying unit's movement for the turn and makes quicksand visible to all. Quicksand duration is unlimited.

none.description:
{Land Mine}

Randomly places four small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts (Spell Power x 10 + 25) damage to any unit walking over it, which doesn’t see it, and disappears. Otherwise landmine duration is unlimited.

basic.description:
{Basic Land Mine}

Randomly places four small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts (Spell Power x 10 + 25) damage to any unit walking over it, which doesn’t see it, and disappears. Otherwise landmine duration is unlimited.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Land Mine}

Randomly places six small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts (Spell Power x 10 + 50) damage to any unit walking over it, which doesn’t see it, and disappears. Otherwise landmine duration is unlimited.

expert.description:
{Expert Land Mine}

Randomly places eight small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts (Spell Power x 10 + 100) damage to any unit walking over it, which doesn’t see it, and disappears. Otherwise landmine duration is unlimited.

none.description:
{Force Field}

Places a 2-hex Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds. Movement through these hexes is blocked.

basic.description:
{Basic Force Field}

Places a 2-hex Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds. Movement through these hexes is blocked.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Force Field}

Places a 3-hex Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds. Movement through these hexes is blocked.

expert.description:
{Expert Force Field}

Places a 3-hex Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds. Movement through these hexes is blocked.

Randomly damages two sections of castle wall, gate or tower in combat.

basic.description:

Randomly damages two sections of castle wall, gate or tower in combat.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Earthquake}

Randomly damages three sections of castle wall, gate or tower in combat.

expert.description:

Randomly damages four sections of castle wall, gate or tower in combat.

expert.description:

Ice drains the body heat from the selected enemy unit. Inflicts (Spell Power x 20 + 10) damage.

basic.description:

advanced.description:

expert.description:

Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected enemy unit. It takes (Spell Power x 25 + 10) damage.

Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected enemy unit. It takes (Spell Power x 25 + 10) damage.

advanced.description:

Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected enemy unit. It takes (Spell Power x 25 + 20) damage.

expert.description:

Inflicts (Spell Power x 75 + 100) damage to a single enemy creature stack. Does not affect War Machines.

{Basic Implosion}

Inflicts (Spell Power x 75 + 100) damage to a single enemy creature stack. Does not affect War Machines.

advanced.description:

Inflicts (Spell Power x 75 + 200) damage to a single enemy creature stack. Does not affect War Machines.

Inflicts (Spell Power x 75 + 300) damage to a single enemy creature stack. Does not affect War Machines.

none.description:
{Chain Lightning}

Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected enemy unit for (Spell Power x 40 + 25) damage which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half of previous target damage, etc.  Strikes four units.

basic.description:
{Basic Chain Lightning}

Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected enemy unit for (Spell Power x 40 + 25) damage which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half of previous target damage, etc.  Strikes four units.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Chain Lightning}

Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected enemy unit for (Spell Power x 40 + 50) damage which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half of previous target damage, etc.  Strikes five units.

expert.description:
{Expert Chain Lightning}

Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected enemy unit for (Spell Power x 40 + 100) damage which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half of previous target damage, etc.  Strikes five units.

none.description:
{Frost Ring}

Ice drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 15) damage. Target hex is unaffected.

basic.description:

Ice drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 15) damage. Target hex is unaffected.

advanced.description:

Ice drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 30) damage. Target hex is unaffected.

expert.description:

Ice drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 60) damage. Target hex is unaffected.

Causes the selected target to burst into flames, inflicting (Spell Power x 10 + 15) fire damage to the target and any units adjacent to target location.

Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target and any units 1 and 2 hexes away from target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 20) damage.  Don't be near this when it goes off!

basic.description:
{Basic Inferno}

Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target and any units 1 and 2 hexes away from target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 20) damage.  Don't be near this when it goes off!

advanced.description:

Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target and any units 1 and 2 hexes away from target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 40) damage.  Don't be near this when it goes off!

expert.description:

Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target and any units 1 and 2 hexes away from target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 80) damage.  Don't be near this when it goes off!

none.description:
{Meteor Shower}

Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any units adjacent to target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 25 + 25) damage.

basic.description:
{Basic Meteor Shower}

Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any units adjacent to target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 25 + 25) damage.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Meteor Shower}

Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any units adjacent to target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 25 + 50) damage.

expert.description:
{Expert Meteor Shower}

Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any units adjacent to target location. Each unit takes (Spell Power x 25 + 100) damage.

none.description:
{Death Ripple}

Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all units except undead and War Mañhines for (Spell Power x 5 + 10) hit points.

basic.description:
{Basic Death Ripple}

Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all units except undead and War Mañhines for (Spell Power x 5 + 10) hit points.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Death Ripple}

Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all units except undead and War Mañhines for (Spell Power x 5 + 20) hit points.

expert.description:
{Expert Death Ripple}

Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all units except undead and War Mañhines for (Spell Power x 5 + 30) hit points.

none.description:
{Destroy Undead}

Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield. Each undead unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 10) damage.

basic.description:
{Basic Destroy Undead}

Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield. Each undead unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 10) damage.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Destroy Undead}

Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield. Each undead unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 20) damage.

expert.description:
{Expert Destroy Undead}

Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield. Each undead unit takes (Spell Power x 10 + 50) damage.

none.description:
{Shield}

Shields a selected friendly unit, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks by 15%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Shield}

Shields a selected friendly unit, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks by 15%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Shield}

Shields a selected friendly unit, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks by 30%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Shield}

Shields all friendly units, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks by 30%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Air Shield}

Shields a selected friendly unit, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks by 25%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Air Shield}

Shields a selected friendly unit, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks by 25%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Air Shield}

Shields a selected friendly unit, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks by 50%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Air Shield}

Shields all friendly units, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks by 50%. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Fire Shield}

Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy making hand-by-hand attack through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to 20% of what it inflicts. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Fire Shield}

Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy making hand-by-hand attack through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to 20% of what it inflicts. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Fire Shield}

Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy making hand-by-hand attack through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to 25% of what it inflicts. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Fire Shield}

Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy making hand-by-hand attack through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to 30% of what it inflicts. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Anti-magic}

Protects the selected friendly unit from all 1-3 level spells except Dispel. Removes negative spells level 1-3 except Disrupting Ray. Does not affect duplicates created with Clone spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Anti-magic}

Protects the selected friendly unit from all 1-3 level spells except Dispel. Removes negative spells level 1-3 except Disrupting Ray. Does not affect duplicates created with Clone spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Anti-magic}

Protects the selected friendly unit from all 1-4 level spells except Dispel. Removes negative spells level 1-4 except Disrupting Ray. Does not affect duplicates created with Clone spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Anti-magic}

Protects the selected friendly unit from all spells except Dispel. Removes all negative spells except Disrupting Ray. Does not affect duplicates created with Clone spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Dispel}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and poison from a friendly unit. Ignores target creature natural immunities to magic.

basic.description:
{Basic Dispel}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and poison from a friendly unit. Ignores target creature natural immunities to magic.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Dispel}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and poison from a friendly or hostile unit. Ignores target creature chances to resist a spell and natural immunities.

expert.description:
{Expert Dispel}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and poison from all units on the battlefield and destroys all magic obstacles. Ignores target creature chances to resist a spell and natural immunities.

none.description:
{Magic Mirror}

Reflects hostile spells from selected friendly unit towards a random enemy creature 20% of the time. Protects from Hypnotize spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Magic Mirror}

Reflects hostile spells from selected friendly unit towards a random enemy creature 20% of the time. Protects from Hypnotize spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Magic Mirror}

Reflects hostile spells from selected friendly unit towards a random enemy creature 30% of the time. Protects from Hypnotize spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Magic Mirror}

Reflects hostile spells from selected friendly unit towards a random enemy creature 40% of the time. Protects from Hypnotize spell. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Cure}

Removes all negative spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and dendroid binding and heals (Spell Power x 5 + 10) hit points on the selected friendly unit. Restores health decremented with poison.

basic.description:
{Basic Cure}

Removes all negative spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and dendroid binding and heals (Spell Power x 5 + 10) hit points on the selected friendly unit. Restores health decremented with poison.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Cure}

Removes all negative spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and dendroid binding and heals (Spell Power x 5 + 20) hit points on the selected friendly unit. Restores health decremented with poison.

expert.description:
{Expert Cure}

Removes all negative spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and dendroid binding and heals (Spell Power x 5 + 30) hit points on all friendly units. Restores health decremented with poison.

none.description:
{Resurrection}

Resurrects units in the selected friendly group of living creatures until the end of the battle by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 40) hit points to the target.

basic.description:
{Basic Resurrection}

Resurrects units in the selected friendly group of living creatures until the end of the battle by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 40) hit points to the target.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Resurrection}

Resurrects units in the selected friendly group of living creatures permanently by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 80) hit points to the target.

expert.description:
{Expert Resurrection}

Resurrects units in the selected friendly group of living creatures permanently by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 160) hit points to the target.

none.description:

Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected friendly group by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 30) hit points to the target.

basic.description:
{Basic Animate Dead}

advanced.description:

Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected friendly group by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 60) hit points to the target.

expert.description:
{Expert Animate Dead}

Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected friendly group by restoring (Spell Power x 50 + 160) hit points to the target.

none.description:
{Sacrifice}

Permanently destroys a friendly living creature group in order to resurrect another friendly living creature group.  Resurrection power is ((Spell Power + Sacrificed Troop's Creature Base Health + 3) x Number of Creatures Sacrificed) hit points.

basic.description:
{Basic Sacrifice}

Permanently destroys a friendly living creature group in order to resurrect another friendly living creature group.  Resurrection power is ((Spell Power + Sacrificed Troop's Creature Base Health + 3) x Number of Creatures Sacrificed) hit points.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Sacrifice}

Permanently destroys a friendly living creature group in order to resurrect another friendly living creature group.  Resurrection power is ((Spell Power + Sacrificed Troop's Creature Base Health + 6) x Number of Creatures Sacrificed) hit points.

{Expert Sacrifice}

none.description:
{Bless}

Causes the selected friendly unit to inflict maximum damage in combat. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Bless}

Causes the selected friendly unit to inflict maximum damage in combat. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Bless}

Causes the selected friendly unit to inflict damage, greater than their normal maximum damage in combat by 1. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Bless}

Causes all friendly units to inflict damage, greater than their normal maximum damage in combat by 1. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Curse}

Causes the selected enemy unit to inflict minimum damage in combat. Removes Bless effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Curse}

Causes the selected enemy unit to inflict minimum damage in combat. Removes Bless effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Curse}

Causes the selected enemy unit to inflict damage, less than their normal minimum damage in combat by 1. Removes Bless effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Curse}

Causes all enemy units to inflict damage, less than their normal minimum damage in combat by 1. Removes Bless effect. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Bloodlust}

Increases the hand-to-hand attack strength of the selected friendly unit by 3. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Bloodlust}

Increases the hand-to-hand attack strength of the selected friendly unit by 6. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Bloodlust}

Increases the hand-to-hand attack strength of all friendly units by 6. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Precision}

Increases the attack strength of the selected friendly unit ranged attack by 3. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Precision}

Increases the attack strength of the selected friendly unit ranged attack by 6. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:

none.description:

Reduces the selected enemy unit's attack strength by 3. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Frenzy}

Mind spell. Selected friendly troop intentionally lowers its defenses to 0 to increase the ferocity of its attack. Bonus to attack strength is equal to unit’s former defense. The spell takes effect immediately and lasts during the closest turn of the target. After that, the spell effect lasts until the beginning of the target next turn.

basic.description:
{Basic Frenzy}

Mind spell. Selected friendly troop intentionally lowers its defenses to 0 to increase the ferocity of its attack. Bonus to attack strength is equal to unit’s former defense. The spell takes effect immediately and lasts during the closest turn of the target. After that, the spell effect lasts until the beginning of the target next turn.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Frenzy}

Mind spell. Selected friendly troop intentionally lowers its defenses to 0 to increase the ferocity of its attack. Bonus to attack strength is 1.5 times more than unit’s former defense. The spell takes effect immediately and lasts during the closest turn of the target. After that, the spell effect lasts until the beginning of the target next turn.

expert.description:
{Expert Frenzy}

Mind spell. Selected friendly troop intentionally lowers its defenses to 0 to increase the ferocity of its attack. Bonus to attack strength is 2 times more than unit’s former defense. The spell takes effect immediately and lasts during the closest turn of the target. After that, the spell effect lasts until the beginning of the target next turn.

none.description:
{Counterstrike}

The selected friendly unit gains one additional retaliation attack immediately and will gain one additional retaliation attack at the beginning of each round. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Counterstrike}

The selected friendly unit gains one additional retaliation attack immediately and will gain one additional retaliation attack at the beginning of each round. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Counterstrike}

The selected friendly unit gains two additional retaliation attacks immediately and will gain two additional retaliations attack at the beginning of each round. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Counterstrike}

All friendly units gain two additional retaliation attacks immediately and will gain two additional retaliations attack at the beginning of each round. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Berserk}

Mind spell. The targeted unit will randomly attack the nearest unit, be it friend or foe. Hypnotize effect is dispelled from target. Spell effect is valid until target make an attack, otherwise Berserk duration is unlimited.

basic.description:
{Basic Berserk}

Mind spell. The targeted unit will randomly attack the nearest unit, be it friend or foe. Hypnotize effect is dispelled from target. Spell effect is valid until target make an attack, otherwise Berserk duration is unlimited.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Berserk}

Mind spell. The targeted unit as well as units adjacent to the target location will randomly attack the nearest units, be they friends or foes. Hypnotize effect is dispelled from targets. Spell effect is valid until target make an attack, otherwise Berserk duration is unlimited.

expert.description:
{Expert Berserk}

Mind spell. The targeted unit as well as any units 1 and 2 hexes away from target location will randomly attack the nearest units, be they friends or foes. Hypnotize effect is dispelled from targets. Spell effect is valid until target make an attack, otherwise Berserk duration is unlimited.

none.description:
{Hypnotize}

Mind spell. Puts the selected enemy unit of not more than (Spell Power x 25 + 10) Health temporarily under your control. Removes Berserk effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Hypnotize}

Mind spell. Puts the selected enemy unit of not more than (Spell Power x 25 + 10) Health temporarily under your control. Removes Berserk effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Hypnotize}

Mind spell. Puts the selected enemy unit of not more than (Spell Power x 25 + 20) Health temporarily under your control. Removes Berserk effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Hypnotize}

Mind spell. Puts the selected enemy unit of not more than (Spell Power x 25 + 50) Health temporarily under your control. Removes Berserk effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Forgetfulness}

Mind spell. Half of the selected enemy ranged unit forgets to use its attack. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Forgetfulness}

Mind spell. Half of the selected enemy ranged unit forgets to use its attack. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Forgetfulness}

Mind spell. Causes the selected enemy ranged unit to forget to use its ranged attack in combat. Half of unit also forget to use hand-to-hand attack. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Forgetfulness}

Mind spell. Causes all enemy ranged troops to forget to use their ranged attack in combat. Half of each unit also forget to use hand-to-hand attack. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

none.description:
{Blind}

Mind spell. Temporary blinds the selected enemy unit so that it cannot move and causes it to counterattack at half its normal damage.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

basic.description:
{Basic Blind}

Mind spell. Temporary blinds the selected enemy unit so that it cannot move and causes it to counterattack at half its normal damage.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Blind}

Mind spell. Temporary blinds the selected enemy unit so that it cannot move and causes it to counterattack at one-quarter of its normal damage.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

expert.description:
{Expert Blind}

Mind spell. Temporary blinds the selected enemy unit so that it cannot move or counterattack.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled. Does not affect undead. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

{Expert Teleport}

Teleports any friendly unit to any unoccupied spot on the battlefield. Removes dendroid binding effect.

none.description:
{Remove Obstacle}

Removes any normal non-integrated obstacle (trees, rocks, etc.) of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

basic.description:
{Basic Remove Obstacle}

Removes any normal non-integrated obstacle (trees, rocks, etc.) of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Remove Obstacle}

Removes any normal non-integrated obstacle (trees, rocks, etc.) or Fire Wall of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

expert.description:
{Expert Remove Obstacle}

Removes any normal non-integrated or magical obstacle of the caster's choice from the battlefield.
